name: awesome-sar
desc: A curated list of awesome Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) software, libraries, and resources.

resources.name: SNAP
resources.desc: Sentinel Application Platform.

resources.name: Orfeo Toolbox (OTB)
resources.desc: Open Source processing of remote sensing images (github, Cookbook: SAR Processing, Guide)

resources.name: Gamma
resources.desc: the Gamma software is a commercial software package that supports the entire processing chain from synthetic aperture radar (SAR) raw data focusing over SAR interferometry, time series analysis, polarimetric decompositions, SAR image filtering to generation of end products such as digital elevation models, ground motion, change detection, and land use mapping etc. Most spaceborne SAR systems, various air-/UAV-borne and terrestrial SAR systems, including the Gamma SAR Systems and the GPRI are supported.

resources.name: SARbian
resources.desc: free and open SAR operating system

resources.name: SARscape
resources.desc: SARscape is a complete set of functions for the end-to-end processing of all spaceborne and selected airborne SAR data.

resources.name: GMTSAR
resources.desc: InSAR processing system combined with GMT.

resources.name: ISCE2
resources.desc: InSAR Scientific Computing Environment.

resources.name: Doris
resources.desc: Delft object-oriented radar interferometric software.

resources.name: PolSARPro
resources.desc: The ESA Polarimetric SAR Data Processing and Educational Tool

resources.name: PolSARPro updates for Linux
resources.desc: A git mirror of the ESA Polarimetric SAR Data Processing and Educational Tool with updates for GNU/Linux compatibility

resources.name: RAT
resources.desc: RAT Radar Tools (discontinued/obsolete)

resources.name: GIAnT
resources.desc: Generic InSAR Analysis Toolbox.

resources.name: MintPy
resources.desc: Miami INsar Time-series software in PYthon.

resources.name: PyRate
resources.desc: A Python tool for Rate and Time-series Estimation

resources.name: SARPROZ
resources.desc: The SAR PROcessing tool by periZ

resources.name: StaMPS/MTI
resources.desc: Stanford Method for Persistent Scatterers - git-version

resources.name: KFTS
resources.desc: A Kalman filter based, sequential time series analysis tool.

resources.name: MPITS
resources.desc: Multi-pixel, full covariance time series analysis tool.

resources.name: PyAPS
resources.desc: Python based Atmospheric Phase Screen Estimation.

resources.name: PySolid
resources.desc: A Python wrapper for solid Earth tides.

resources.name: TRAIN
resources.desc: Toolbox for Reducing Atmospheric InSAR Noise - git-version.

resources.name: ASF Map Ready
resources.desc: MapReady Remote Sensing Tool Kit

resources.name: GDAL
resources.desc: Geospatial Data Abstraction Library

resources.name: GMT
resources.desc: Generic Mapping Tools

resources.name: GRASS
resources.desc: Geographic Resources Analysis Support System

resources.name: GEE Code Editor

resources.name: SSARA
resources.desc: Seamless SAR Archive project repository

resources.name: ArchiveTools
resources.desc: Scripts for downloading and searching data

resources.name: SentinelSat
resources.desc: Search and download Sentinel images from the command line or with the Python API (not working with current Copernicus Data Space).

resources.name: CDSETool
resources.desc: Download data from the Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem (CDSE), including Sentinel-1 data.

resources.name: CopernicusAPi
resources.desc: Another library to download data from Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem (CDSE).

resources.name: EODAG
resources.desc: Command line tool and plugin-oriented Python framework for search and download from multiple providers.

resources.name: EODMS API Client
resources.desc: Search, order and download from NRCan's Earth Observation Data Management System (EODMS) from command line or Python REPL.

resources.name: ARIA-tools
resources.desc: Tools to manipulate (download, cropping, stitching, time-series preparation) ARIA products

resources.name: OPERA
resources.desc: SAR co-registration, SqueeSAR-type InSAR time series analysis, RTC, and surface water mapping tools developed by the JPL Observational Products for End-Users from Remote Sensing Analysis (OPERA) project.

resources.name: PyRAT
resources.desc: General purpose SAR postprocessing framework

resources.name: kite
resources.desc: Quadtree subsampling, data covariance analysis for surface displacement modeling. APS removal (empirical and GACOS). Download data from various data centers.

resources.name: s1tbx
resources.desc: part of SNAP

resources.name: sarpy
resources.desc: Python library for simple processing of complex SAR data using the NGA SICD standard

resources.name: EOReader

resources.name: Sarsen
